newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Oil and Gas to make bonus option issue.
newsitem.headline: NZ Oil and Gas to make bonus option issue.

text.p: NZ Oil and Gas Ltd said on Wednesday it was make a one for two issue of bonus share options to all shareholders.
The options will have a term of about five years and will be exercisable between July 1, 1998 and October 31, 2001 at a price expected to be in a range of 55 to 70 NZ cents.
The options would bring immediate value to shareholders and benefits for the company as they would assist in raising any new equity or debt for future projects.
This benefit would be enhanced by providing optionholders with participating rights to any new issues or offers of securities, similar to the rights of shareholders.

The value of NZ Oil and Gas's assets was more than the current share price, NZOG said. The company said the issue gave investors the opportunity to gain short term exposure to exploration potential. The stock closed at NZ$0.43, up one cent, a high for the year.
